evidence.cloud: Billing, published crawler configuration, URL Tester and completed crawl statistics observed in the Algolia administration UI.
evidence.search: Original fixed 28-query matrix and a separately recorded two-query middle-content recheck; the original unmatched phrases are preserved.
evidence.local: List-transform audit retaining its original counts and preservation assertions; local filesystem locations omitted.
evidence.dataHandling: No keys, account identities or request headers are stored. Search responses are reduced to public target records and necessary content evidence.

dailyFullCrawlEstimate.limitations: Estimate for one full crawl per day; additional manual crawls and site growth are not included.

transform.scope: Only the two exact paths, allowing an optional trailing slash.
transform.operation: Group up to 10 complete direct li children into each temporary p in the crawler DOM; preserve their inner HTML and source order.

unchanged: All other pages retain the original DocSearch helper behavior.
Existing cloud authentication remains in place; no new key is recorded or required.

history.meaning: The initial v4 monthly-schedule snapshot remains historical; it does not describe the current published daily schedule.

transformPreservation.auditScopeNote: The original audit counted all article lists: 781 Markdown-body items plus 3 breadcrumb items, totaling 784. The actual v5 selector is narrower and leaves the breadcrumbs unchanged; the separate scoped actual-code audit below verifies 80 content chunks.

actualCodeAudit.method: Executed the checked-in v5 recordExtractor in a Node vm with a Crawler capture stub and Cheerio on existing bilingual build HTML; helpers.docsearch was a DOM-observation stub. No network, cloud write or real DocSearch helper execution.

originalMatrix.method: Read-only search; one query per title, four endpoint queries, two old-page controls, two changelog titles, four strict changelog body queries; no polling, browse, settings, or write operation

strictPhraseDiagnostics.interpretation: These original quoted phrase queries remain unmatched. The separate unquoted query returns the full original phrase in each target record, establishing that this content is indexed; it does not establish the precise tokenization or phrase-matching cause.

summary.conclusion: Published daily configuration and the completed zero-failure crawl are verified. Selected page, endpoint, middle-content and tail-content targets pass. The two original strict phrase diagnostics did not match and are not reported as passed.
limitations: This is a bounded 30-request audit, not an exhaustive browse of the index or a guarantee of future ranking.
A completed manual crawl verifies v5 execution; it does not by itself prove a future scheduled invocation.
Website deployment does not apply the cloud crawler configuration or automatically update the search index.

browserValidation.meaning: The actual website search modal returned the changelog content and the selected result opened the correct language page and section.
